script:
#!/bin/sh
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin
d=${0%/*}
US=$(printf '\037'); l=M; for a in "$@"; do l="$l$US$a"; done
printf '%s\n' "$l" >> "$d/log"
[ -f "$d/stderr" ] && cat "$d/stderr" >&2
[ -f "$d/stdout" ] && cat "$d/stdout"
[ -f "$d/exit" ] && exit "$(cat "$d/exit")"
exit 0
